text: Implement the pre-registered paired-run autonomy benchmark contract and analyzer
description: Add a deterministic benchmark contract in wrapped-agents/common for comparing graph-grounded and stateless runs under the same model, task, tool, token, and time budgets. Freeze representative task descriptors and injected-failure conditions; accept structured run evidence; reject incomplete, duplicated, or budget-mismatched pairs; compute verified completion, human interventions, wall time, token/tool cost, recovery, and policy violations. Report a positive result only when graph grounding improves completion or materially reduces interventions without more policy violations. Add tests for positive, null, negative, invalid, and incomplete results. This implements the pre-registration and analyzer, not the actual model runs or the parent hypothesis result.
reflection: Implemented autonomy benchmark protocol 2026-08-01.v1 with four frozen task classes, paired graph-grounded/stateless run evidence, exact model/tool/token/time matching, evidence requirements, aggregate metrics, and positive/null/negative/invalid outcomes. A test exposed and drove correction of a rule that could have rewarded lower intervention despite worse completion; the final rule requires non-worse completion and non-worse safety. Verification: wrapped-agents common 77/77 tests passed, TypeScript type-check passed, git diff check passed. No actual model runs were performed, so the parent hypothesis remains unproven.

reflections.context: Needed a controlled attribution test for Aimparency's autonomy benefit.
reflections.outcome: Created a frozen paired-run contract and analyzer; corrected an initially permissive intervention-saving rule after a failing test.
reflections.effectiveness: Strong pre-registration and validation foundation, but no empirical agent result yet.
reflections.lesson: Efficiency gains must never compensate for worse verified completion or safety.
reflections.pattern: Capability comparisons need matched budgets, authoritative evidence, and explicit null/negative outcomes.

valueRationale: A paired, budget-matched protocol is necessary to attribute any observed gain to Aimparency rather than model, task, or resource differences.
